title: Password Construction Guidelines
summary: This policy provides best practices for creating strong passwords to protect user accounts and organizational systems. It outlines recommended password characteristics and the use of additional security measures such as password managers and multi-factor authentication.
scope: This guideline applies to employees, contractors, consultants, temporary and other workers, including all personnel affiliated with third parties. This guideline applies to all passwords including but not limited to user-level accounts, system-level accounts, web accounts, e-mail accounts, screen saver protection, voicemail, and local router logins.

requirements.text: We recommend a minimum of 14 characters in your password.
We highly encourage the use of passphrases, passwords made up of multiple words.
Every work account should have a different, unique password.
We highly encourage the use of ‘password manager’ software that is authorized and provided by the organization.
Whenever possible, also enable the use of multi-factor authentication.
